Map: Glutamate - NMDA and AMPA receptors - action potential
Why: glutamate carries every nociceptive signal to the dorsal horn
Note: NMDA (GluN2B) and AMPA (GluA1) subunits rise in the dorsal horn with OA pain; central sensitisation depends on them.
